description: Full buying-pressure + holder-health report for ONE Solana memecoin (mint address in). BUYING PRESSURE: deterministic constant-product math on live pool reserves — the exact net quote inflow that moves the price to 1.5x, 2x, 3x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x and 100x, with target prices and target market caps, plus the gross inflow after the venue fee. Works for pump.fun bonding curves (virtual reserves read from the curve account, pre-graduation), PumpSwap and Raydium constant-product pools; concentrated pools (CLMM/DLMM) are reported unavailable with the reason, never approximated. HOLDER HEALTH: cost basis reconstructed from public chain history over a bounded top-holder sample (pool vaults excluded) — total unrealized PnL, percent of sampled wallets in profit, supply-weighted average cost, MVRV, UPNL vs liquidity, per-holder detail, and the sample coverage (% of supply) stated up front. Includes a canonical-contract check for tracked narratives (NEET at launch): clones trading on the name are flagged and the real contract named. Every report carries its methodology (pool type, reserves snapshot slot, fee assumption, holder sample bounds) and names its data gaps — figures that cannot be computed from public state are reported unavailable, never estimated. Cost: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 (Base settlement; Solana settlement when configured) — no API key needed. Use it to answer 'how much money has to arrive for this to 2x / 10x, and are the holders sitting on profit or underwater?' before sizing into any Solana memecoin.

mint.description: Solana token mint address (base58, 32-44 chars), e.g. Ce2gx9KGXJ6C9Mp5b5x1sn9Mg87JwEbrQby4Zqo3pump. EVM 0x addresses are rejected — this is a Solana tool.
